data.name: The Realm
data.detailed_description:
Awaken in a forgotten land with no memory of who you are.

Guided only by a mysterious spirit, you set out on a journey to recover the five legendary Crystal Shards, ancient relics said to hold the power to restore what was lost. But the world is far from abandoned. Twisted creatures roam the wilderness, forgotten dungeons guard powerful secrets, and towering bosses stand between you and the truth.

The Realm is an open-world fantasy RPG focused on exploration, challenging combat, and rewarding discovery. Venture through forests, villages, caves, castles, and dangerous ruins, uncover hidden treasures, master powerful magic, and grow stronger as you piece together the mystery of your past.

Every Crystal Shard brings you closer to unlocking the secrets of the Realm, but something ancient is watching your every move.

Explore a Living World

Travel freely across a handcrafted fantasy world filled with unique locations, hidden paths, and rewarding secrets. Meet villagers, discover forgotten landmarks, and uncover treasures scattered throughout the land.

Master Powerful Magic

Wield a growing arsenal of magical spells, each offering unique ways to defeat your enemies. Experiment with different abilities, adapt your playstyle, and overcome increasingly dangerous foes.

Face Epic Boss Battles

Every major dungeon culminates in a challenging boss encounter that tests your skill, strategy, and mastery of your abilities. Learn their attack patterns, exploit their weaknesses, and claim powerful rewards.

Discover Hidden Dungeons

Explore mysterious caves, ancient temples, forgotten ruins, and dangerous underground chambers. Each dungeon offers unique enemies, environmental challenges, valuable loot, and pieces of the Realm's forgotten history.

Become Stronger

Find new equipment, unlock powerful abilities, and improve your character as you progress. The deeper you explore, the greater the rewards and the greater the dangers that await.

Features

  • A handcrafted open-world fantasy adventure

  • Explore forests, villages, ruins, castles, and hidden dungeons

  • Fast-paced action combat with powerful magical spells

  • Challenging boss fights with unique mechanics

  • Secrets, treasures, and optional areas to discover

  • Character progression through equipment and abilities

  • A mysterious story centered around the five Crystal Shards

  • Beautiful fantasy environments brought to life with dynamic lighting and atmosphere

Will you recover your memories... or uncover a truth that was meant to remain forgotten?
